SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.producer_id AS producerId, p.base_category_id AS baseCategoryId, p.name AS name, p.summary AS summary, p.main_image AS mainImage, p.status AS status, p.created_date AS createdDate,
d.detail_id AS detailId, d.unit_name AS unitName, d.price AS price, d.grade AS grade
FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_detail d ON p.product_id = d.product_id
AND p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND p.base_category_id IN
#{c}
AND d.price <= #{price}
ORDER BY d.price ASC ORDER BY d.price DESC ORDER BY p.created_date DESC ORDER BY p.product_id DESC

SELECT image_id AS imageId, product_id AS productId, image_url AS imageUrl, is_main AS isMain, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_date AS createdDate
FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{value} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT store_id AS storeId, producer_id AS producerId, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, store_name AS storeName, phone, addr, addr_detail AS addrDetail, region_si, region_gun AS regionGun, description, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, status, is_active AS isActive, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM store WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.producer_id AS producerId, p.main_image AS mainImage, p.name AS name, d.price AS price, d.stock_qty AS stockQty, p.created_date AS createdDate FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_detail d ON p.product_id = d.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} ORDER BY p.created_date DESC

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.producer_id AS producerId, p.name AS name, d.price AS price, d.stock_qty AS stockQty, p.sales_count AS salesCount FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_detail d ON p.product_id = d.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.producer_id AS producerId, p.name AS name, d.price AS price, d.stock_qty AS stockQty, p.created_date AS createdDate FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_detail d ON p.product_id = d.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} ORDER BY p.created_date DESC LIMIT 10
